mapper.sql:
FROM SALE h JOIN SALE_LINE l ON l.SALE_ID = h.SALE_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM i ON i.ITEM_ID = l.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN SALES_ORDER_LINE source_line ON source_line.SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID = l.SALES_ORDER_LINE_ID LEFT JOIN SALES_ORDER source_header ON source_header.SALES_ORDER_ID = source_line.SALES_ORDER_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT SALE_LINE_ID, SALE_ID, SALE_NO, BUSINESS_DATE, PARTNER_NAME, ASSIGNEE_NAME, WAREHOUSE_NAME, SOURCE_BUSINESS_DATE, SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NO, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, SPECIFICATION, QUANTITY, UNIT, UNIT_PRICE, SUPPLY_AMOUNT, VAT_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, NOTE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, ordered_row.* FROM ( SELECT l.SALE_LINE_ID, h.SALE_ID, h.SALE_NO, TO_CHAR(h.BUSINESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
h.BUSINESS_DATE AS SORT_BUSINESS_DATE, h.PARTNER_NAME, h.ASSIGNEE_NAME, h.WAREHOUSE_NAME, TO_CHAR(source_header.BUSINESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SOURCE_BUSINESS_DATE, source_header.SALES_ORDER_NO AS SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NO, i.ITEM_CODE, l.ITEM_NAME, l.SPECIFICATION, l.QUANTITY, l.UNIT, l.UNIT_PRICE, l.SUPPLY_AMOUNT, l.VAT_AMOUNT, l.TOTAL_AMOUNT, l.NOTE, TO_CHAR(h.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(h.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_AT
ORDER BY h.BUSINESS_DATE DESC, h.SALE_ID DESC, l.SALE_LINE_ID ASC ) ordered_row WHERE ROWNUM <= #{page} * #{pageSize} ) WHERE rn > (#{page} - 1) * #{pageSize} ORDER BY SORT_BUSINESS_DATE DESC, SALE_ID DESC, SALE_LINE_ID ASC

SELECT l.SALE_LINE_ID, l.SALE_ID, l.QUANTITY FROM SALE_LINE l JOIN SALE h ON h.SALE_ID = l.SALE_ID WHERE l.SALE_LINE_ID = #{saleLineId} AND l.SALE_ID = #{saleId} AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND h.DELETED_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE SALE_LINE SET UNIT_PRICE = #{unitPrice}, SUPPLY_AMOUNT = #{supplyAmount}, VAT_AMOUNT = #{vatAmount}, TOTAL_AMOUNT = #{totalAmount} WHERE SALE_LINE_ID = #{saleLineId} AND SALE_ID = #{saleId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SALE h WHERE h.SALE_ID = #{saleId} AND h.DELETED_YN = 'N')
UPDATE SALE SET UPDATED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP WHERE SALE_ID = #{saleId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
